$comment: Starter kit source of truth. `node scripts/sync.mjs` resolves every entry against the live plugin index and writes data/verified.json, CATALOG.md and the table in README.md. Edit this file, not the generated output.

plugins.name: dsh-composer-expand
plugins.why: Grows the composer into a tall 70vh writing view for long prompts.

plugins.name: dsh-md-studio
plugins.why: Offline Markdown preview in the right sidebar with Mermaid, KaTeX and GFM tables.

plugins.name: dsh-preview-image
plugins.why: Real zoom, pan, rotate and fullscreen for images, in the preview panel and lightbox.

plugins.name: media-preview
plugins.why: Turns local audio and video paths into inline playable players in the chat.

plugins.name: dsh-artifact-preview
plugins.why: Adds a produced-files card row plus a resizable split preview for workspace artifacts.

plugins.name: dsh-database-preview
plugins.why: Read-only browsing of SQLite files and MySQL, Postgres and SQL Server connections.

plugins.name: dsh-session-kanban
plugins.why: Sidebar board showing every session's current work, todos and progress.

plugins.name: dsh-session-export
plugins.why: Writes styled HTML, Markdown or JSON transcripts with diffs and a turn timeline.

plugins.name: dsh-notification
plugins.why: Native desktop and webhook alerts when a turn ends, errors or waits for approval.

plugins.name: dsh-desktop-notifications
plugins.why: Windows toast notifications that carry the conversation name.

plugins.name: @faith1688/dsh-usage-meter-harness
plugins.why: Balance plus a per-turn, per-session and per-model cost ledger.

plugins.name: dsh-token-ledger-pro
plugins.why: Prices every request against a built-in catalog of 136 models across 16 providers.

plugins.name: @restregular/dsh-memory
plugins.why: Local JSONL memory with per-scope dedup and five memory tools.

plugins.name: @hr98w/dsh-memory
plugins.why: Leaner auto-memory and session consolidation modelled on Claude Code and Codex.

plugins.name: dsh-git-changes
plugins.why: Right-sidebar review panel with inline and side-by-side diffs, stage, commit, push.

plugins.name: dsh-git-management
plugins.why: Fuller git panel: commit graph, worktrees, branches and pull requests.

plugins.name: dsh-git-badge
plugins.why: Git state badges on sidebar workspace rows and a composer chip.

plugins.name: @goodandready/dsh-shadow-auditor
plugins.why: Background scan of agent output for leaked secrets, plus command safety checks.

plugins.name: dsh-ears
plugins.why: Microphone button that turns speech into a draft, with pluggable speech engines.

plugins.name: dsh-voice-mode
plugins.why: Full-duplex voice mode and hold-to-talk dictation.

plugins.name: dsh-skill-hub
plugins.why: Browse, search, toggle, inspect and scaffold local skills from inside the GUI.

plugins.name: dsh-remote-mobile
plugins.why: Tailscale or LAN access with QR pairing, RSA encryption and brute-force defense.
